subject: Support coverage & escalation matrix — TAM hours, on-call, and incident comms
messages:
From: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa.morgan@finserve.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: RFI follow-up — TAM hours & incident comms for enterprise SOC review

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security and ops teams are consolidating the RFI responses and have a couple of clarifying asks around Customer Success / TAM coverage and incident communications. Specifically:

- Can you confirm the standard TAM coverage hours (PST) for Dedicated customers vs Private (VPC) customers?
- Is there a documented escalation matrix and SLA for P1/P2 incidents (response vs remediation targets)?
- What are the supported on-call handoffs and how do you notify customers during an active incident (email, in-console banner, PagerDuty webhook)?

If possible, can you attach the on-call/escalation matrix and a short description of what customers should expect for a high-severity outage? Procurement also asked for a single PDF they can attach to the RFP packet.

Appreciate it — we need the materials by Monday to hit our internal review.

Best,
Alyssa
Senior Security Program Manager
FinServe

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa.morgan@finserve.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI follow-up — TAM hours & incident comms for enterprise SOC review

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching two artifacts that should cover everything: an on-call/escalation matrix (spreadsheet) and a concise RFI-ready PDF that summarizes support SLAs and notification channels. High-level answers below; see attachments for the detailed table and examples of alert flows.

1) TAM coverage (standard):
- Dedicated customers (reserved capacity): Primary TAM hours 06:00–18:00 PST, Mon–Fri. On-call pool covers nights/weekends with 60-min initial response for P1s.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): TAM hours 08:00–18:00 PST, Mon–Fri, with optional 24x7 coverage add-on that includes a named on-call TAM and 30-min P1 response SLA.

2) Escalation & SLAs (summary):
- P1 (service down / data loss): Initial ack within 30–60 minutes depending on tier; remediation target defined in contract/SLAs (typical target 4–8 hours for hosted fallbacks, varies for on-prem).
- P2 (degraded service): Initial ack within 4 hours; remediation target 24–72 hours depending on root cause and mitigations.
- P3/P4: standard ticketing cadence and prioritization — handled during TAM hours.

3) Notification channels:
- Primary: customer-defined PagerDuty integration (webhook) and in-console incident banner for Hosted/Dedicated.
- Secondary: email distribution list (configured per-account) and SMS for named on-call contacts if 24x7 coverage is purchased.

I also included suggested on-call rotation and handoff text we use internally so FinServe can mirror it. Karthik / Marissa — I flagged a couple of optional items in the spreadsheet where we should confirm FinServe preferences (e.g., require 24x7 TAM, PagerDuty vs Opsgenie).

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: FinServe_TAM_Oncall_Matrix_v3.xlsx, RFI_Support_Answers_FinServe.pdf

Subject: Re: RFI follow-up — TAM hours & incident comms for enterprise SOC review

Alyssa — quick note from the sales/contracting side. Two procurement items to flag that will change SLA tables:

- Multi-region failover requirement: if FinServe requires cross-region automatic failover, that shifts the remediation targets and we should add the Dedicated + DR add-on.
- Audit trail retention for incident logs: standard retention is 90 days; extended retention is available via Redwood Optimize (paid add-on).

If you want, happy to schedule a 30-min call with your security folks and our CS/engineering on Monday to walk the matrix live. Laura — can you confirm your availability?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: RFI follow-up — TAM hours & incident comms for enterprise SOC review

Laura / Karthik — thanks, this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications after reviewing the spreadsheet:

- For Dedicated (we will likely take Dedicated across two regions) we want the 24x7 named TAM option on the table; can you provide updated pricing delta for that add-on?
- For P1 response, can you confirm whether the 30–60 minute initial ack is human ack (TAM) or automated system acknowledgement? We need a recorded human acknowledgement for P1s for our audit.
- Can you add a short example timeline for a P1 in the PDF (ack → triage → remediation → postmortem) with expected customer touchpoints?

If you can send an updated PDF with the sample timeline and a follow-up note on pricing by EOD Thursday, we will include it in our RFP packet. Also please include the Drive link to the live matrix for our security reviewers.

Best,
Alyssa
